title: IDS - Data Mentah & Olahan
description: Alur pengolahan data: log syslog mentah MikroTik -> 9 fitur perilaku (hasil olahan) -> skor anomali & keputusan. Revisi penguji sidang.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Log" FROM syslogs WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Analisis" FROM intrusion_results WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(record_count), 0) AS "Log/analisis" FROM intrusion_results WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND record_count IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Intrusi" FROM intrusion_results WHERE time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND is_intrusion = true

panels.title: TAHAP 1 - Data Mentah: Log Syslog MikroTik (50 terbaru)
panels.description: Log asli yang ditarik dari router melalui remote syslog UDP 514, sebelum diolah.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "Waktu", node_id AS "Node", source_ip AS "IP Sumber", event_type AS "Jenis Event", protocol AS "Proto", source_port AS "Port Asal", dest_port AS "Port Tujuan", raw_message AS "Pesan Mentah" FROM syslogs ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: TAHAP 2 & 3 - Data Diolah: 9 Fitur per IP -> Skor & Keputusan (50 terbaru)
panels.description: Setiap baris = satu analisis. Kolom fitur adalah hasil olahan dari log mentah dalam jendela 10 menit; skor & keputusan adalah keluaran Isolation Forest + Decision Engine.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "Waktu", source_ip AS "IP Sumber", record_count AS "Jml Log", (features->>'total_requests')::float AS "total_requests", (features->>'unique_dest_ports')::float AS "unique_dest_ports", (features->>'unique_src_ports')::float AS "unique_src_ports", (features->>'login_fails')::float AS "login_fails", (features->>'port_scans')::float AS "port_scans", (features->>'brute_forces')::float AS "brute_forces", (features->>'requests_per_minute')::float AS "req_per_min", (features->>'port_diversity_ratio')::float AS "port_diversity", (features->>'fail_ratio')::float AS "fail_ratio", anomaly_score AS "Skor", confidence AS "Keyakinan", action_taken AS "Aksi" FROM intrusion_results WHERE features IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Skor Anomali dari Waktu ke Waktu (negatif = anomali)

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, anomaly_score AS "Skor" FROM intrusion_results WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rata-rata Fitur: Normal vs Intrusi (24 jam)
panels.description: Perbandingan nilai mentah rata-rata tiap fitur antara IP normal dan IP terdeteksi intrusi.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f."Fitur", AVG(CASE WHEN NOT is_intrusion THEN f.val END) AS "Normal", AVG(CASE WHEN is_intrusion THEN f.val END) AS "Intrusi" FROM intrusion_results ir, LATERAL (VALUES ('total_requests',(features->>'total_requests')::float), ('unique_dest_ports',(features->>'unique_dest_ports')::float), ('login_fails',(features->>'login_fails')::float), ('requests_per_minute',(features->>'requests_per_minute')::float), ('port_diversity_ratio',(features->>'port_diversity_ratio')::float), ('fail_ratio',(features->>'fail_ratio')::float)) AS f("Fitur", val) WHERE ir.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND features IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f."Fitur" ORDER BY f."Fitur"
